name: <plugin-name>
description: Template for an extraction plugin service. Replace name, description, url and version.

extensions.description: Skill id in message.metadata['sandman.skill']; input = one data part; result = task artifact 'result' with one data part; errors in status message metadata 'sandman.error'.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Plugin inbound token (secret plugin_in_<plugin>), presented by the calling SANDMAN agent

skills.name: Extract (plugin)
skills.description: Returns elements, relations and explicit references for the given artifacts. Must not write to the KG.
